'''Contracting and Licensing''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Financial Division]]. The division was responsible for organizing contracts from sponsors and non-sponsors, and well as marketing Authority products such as entertainment programs outside the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
